android.desc:
In Lexatious, you race against an opponent to form a path of letters across a 15x15 board.  Letters placed on the board must form valid words from the dictionary.  Lexatious is a turn-based game, so take all the time you need to plot your move.

Play against a friend, or one of three different AI opponents with different skill levels.

On each turn, choose whether to play offensively by advancing your path, or defensively to block your opponent.  Keep an eye on what letters you are leaving in your rack for the next turn.  Anticipate where your opponent is likely to want to play next and get there first!

quotes.text:
If anyone is interested in trying out a novel variant of Scrabble, please check out my game Lexatious, available for Android and iOS.  Can be played single-player (against a bot) or two-player.

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.egjackson.lexatious
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/lexatious/id1614332855

In a nutshell you race to form a path of words across a board, while your opponent tries to form a path from the top to the bottom.
quotes.story_title: On the insanity of being a Scrabble enthusiast
